contexts.text: They have seduced Egypt the corner stone of the tribes (); where it is called the corner stone of the tribes, as serving for a support to the things that are of faith. AC 5044:4.
How shameful and filthy things are perceived by the Angels... They may be compared to angular and pointed things, when deprived of their angularity and prickliness. SE 1995:end.
In the corner of a bed () = in the lowest of the Natural.
Truth is there presented as angular in various forms... Good is presented as round, and continuous.
And thou shalt set upon the four corners (of the ark) (), = stability. Corners = strength and stability... because there is the greatest resistance, and also the connection of the whole. AC 9537.

Since corner = strength and stability, like that of Divine truth from Divine good, the Lord is called the stone of the corner in David; The stone which the builders have rejected has become the head of the corner. And in ; From Judah shall be a cornerstone... Also in ; Jehovah shall found in Zion a stone of proof, a corner of price, of a foundation founded.
In like manner corner = the stability of doctrine from the truth that is from good, in ; Neither shall they take from thee a stone for a corner, and a stone of foundations.
Since by corners is signified stability, horns were placed upon the four corners of the altar.
By corners are also signified strength and power in the following passages. Illustrated.
The rings of the ark were relatively as the ball and socket joints, where the arms are joined to the breast; the corners were as the prominences themselves at that junction.

Boards for the corner of the south southward () = even into interior and inmost things where truth is in light... Corner, when said of the quarters of the world, = where that state is which is designated and signified by the quarter.

All states of good of love and truth of faith are signified by the four corners of the earth; states of good of love by the corner of the east, and the corner of the west; and states of truth of faith by the corner of the south and of the north. Illustrated.
Upon the four horns of the altar = in every way... Corners = stability and strength; also all things of truth and good; hence by the horns upon the four corners is signified power in every way.
The breadth of the court towards the corner of the sea () = the state of that Heaven as to scientific truths... Here, by the corner of the sea, is understood the corner of the west.
The corner of a bed and the extremity of a couch () = the lowest Natural, which is the external Sensual, and its truth and good.
Whisper in corners.
The head of the corner, is where the two ways branch off.
The angle of incidence.
Preface 3. These were sent to the corners.
In the corner of a bed and in the extremity of a couch = further away from the goods and truths of doctrine.
A hypocrite, when he comes among the wise, either goes away, or betakes himself to a corner in the room, and makes himself invisible, and sits mute.
I saw four Angels standing upon the four corners of the earth (). The four corners of the earth = the universal World of Spirits... AR 858. AE 417.
That corners = quarters, and thence the four corners all the quarters, may be evident from the following places. Illustrated.
Since corners = quarters, they therefore signify all things, as all things of Heaven or of Hell, or of good or truth. Illustrated.
That a corner = the ultimate which supports higher things, as a foundation a house, and thus also all things. Illustrated.

Since all truth of doctrine from the Word is founded upon the acknowledgement of the Lord, the Lord is called... the stone of the corner which the builders have rejected.... That the stone of a corner is a stone of the foundations, is evident from .
They then toss it into a corner.
Calvin betook himself to a corner of that Society.
They sit in the corners. SE 4830.
(On the corners in the World of Spirits at the time of the Last Judgment.) SE 5452. SE 5458. SE 5466. SE 5467. SE 5470.
The way which leads to Heaven is the same way (for all) as far as the corner stone. General article.
The four corners of the earth and the four winds of heaven () = all truths and goods of the Church in the complex.
The corner = truth protecting.
Corners = the extremes, and thus signify all things, because they include them. AE 417:4. AE 417:5. Illustrated.
The corner stone = all Divine truth upon which Heaven and the Church are founded; and as the foundation is the ultimate on which the house or temple rests, it = all things. Illustrated.
Corner stone = the truth of the natural man, which is called scientific truth.
The corners that shall be devastated () = the truths and goods of the Church in the whole complex.
The corner stone = their foundation.
